summary.headline: Parental Death and Brothers
summary.text: Astrological rules for determining whether the father or mother dies first, including the effects of malefics, lights, planetary degrees, houses, aspects, childbirth, disease, violence, and foreign travel. The text then begins discussing the number of brothers, citing Hecuba’s nineteen children and a mother in Byzantium with twenty-four, alongside polygamy, polyadelphy, and polytekny.
